scope: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M D8 Q4 gate/up local32 small-expert hybrid diagnostic on gfx1151

design.production: local128, output128 x rows32, four waves, eight rows per wave
design.candidate: local32, output128 x rows8, one wave, eight rows per wave
design.hybrid: one shared D8 activation pack; production rows32 kernel for experts with at least nine rows; local32 rows8 kernel for experts with one to eight rows
design.weight_cache: unchanged decoded T16 LDS cache and packed-dot arithmetic

correctness.red: first focused run exposed uninitialized metadata for columns 32..127 after block shrink
correctness.repair: metadata initialization became thread-strided across all output columns
correctness.green: counts 0/3/7/8, K512, dual N128 passes the CPU-reference KL/top-1 quality gate
correctness.actual_leaf_sanity: hybrid is finite and matches production checksum and max_abs
correctness.full_quality_gate_reason: actual-weight leaf performance rejected the premise

leaf.protocol: actual layer-1 weights and natural pp512 routing; producer-row pack inclusive; two warmups; seven counter-rotated samples; burst=3; hybrid includes both consumer launches

decision: Reject and remove. Serializing output128 weight-cache population onto one wave raises VGPR use to 224 and makes the complete hybrid 15.106% slower despite eliminating three idle compute waves for small experts.
